user.title: Elegoo Spaghetti Detection
user.description: Create one detector for an Elegoo printer camera. The integration only detects failures and fires entities/events; pause, stop, and notify actions stay in your own automations.

data.name: Detector name
data.require_light: Only check while the chamber light is on
data.run_without_printing: Run scheduled detection without print status

data_description.home_assistant_host: URL reachable by the ML server. For Docker on another LAN host, use the HA LAN URL, for example http://192.168.1.90:8123.
data_description.obico_host: Base URL of this project's ML server, for example http://192.168.1.100:3333. The setup checks /hc/ and /debug/image.
data_description.obico_auth_token: Must match ML_API_TOKEN / obico_api_secret configured on the ML server.
data_description.instance_id: Stable slug used in entity IDs. Use a different prefix for each detector, for example elegoo_cc2_left.
data_description.camera: Any HA camera entity. Example from elegoo-homeassistant: camera.elegoo_centauri_carbon2_chamber_camera. Your device name may differ.
data_description.snapshot_url: Optional. Leave empty to use the selected camera entity's Home Assistant camera proxy image. Use this only for unusual cameras.
data_description.print_status_sensor: Optional but recommended. Example: sensor.elegoo_centauri_carbon2_print_status. For Elegoo-style names, the matching current_status sensor is used automatically as an extra guard.
data_description.active_print_states: Comma-separated states that mean printing, for example printing,printing_recovery. Elegoo CC2 usually uses printing.
data_description.chamber_light: Optional. Example: light.elegoo_centauri_carbon2_chamber_light. Used by the light-control setting and by Only check while the chamber light is on.
data_description.require_light: Scheduled checks are skipped while the chamber light is not on, and the status shows Off – chamber light is off. A skipped check never turns the light on, whatever Light control is set to. No effect without a chamber light. The Test button always runs.
data_description.light_control_mode: Choose whether detection should leave the light alone, turn it on and leave it on, or restore the previous light state after each snapshot.
data_description.light_settle_seconds: Seconds to wait after this integration turns on an off light before taking the snapshot. Default is 3 seconds for camera exposure/focus.
data_description.run_without_printing: If no print status sensor is selected, scheduled detection only runs when this is enabled. The Test button always runs one check.
data_description.detection_interval: Seconds between scheduled checks while the print status is active. Examples: 600 for 10 minutes, 900 for 15 minutes.
data_description.warning_threshold: Used when Sensitivity is set to Custom thresholds.
data_description.failure_threshold: Used when Sensitivity is set to Custom thresholds.
data_description.cooldown_seconds: Default is 900 seconds. Scheduled checks with a print status sensor emit one detected event per active print window; result events still fire for every check.
data_description.frames_enabled: Save the camera frame behind every scheduled check, per print, to review after a failed print. The detector fetches the image once and the ML server reads the saved copy from Home Assistant Host. Manual checks are not kept.
data_description.job_id_entity: Optional. An entity whose state is the current job id, for example a printer's task id sensor. Frames of one job are kept together. Without it, a new print starts when the print status sensor becomes active or after 15 minutes without a frame.
data_description.job_name_entity: Optional. An entity whose state is the current job or file name, shown in the frame viewer.
data_description.frames_keep_prints: The oldest prints are removed first.
data_description.frames_max_per_print: Past this, every other frame scored below 10 % is dropped, so a long print keeps its whole timeline at a coarser step.
data_description.frames_max_mb: When this detector's frames take more than this, the oldest prints are removed first.

error.invalid_instance_id: Entity prefix must contain at least one valid slug character.
error.instance_id_exists: This entity prefix is already used by another detector.
error.warning_above_failure: Warning threshold must be lower than or equal to failure threshold.
error.camera_image_unavailable: The selected camera does not expose an entity_picture URL. Try another camera or set a direct snapshot URL.
error.ml_health_failed: The ML server health check failed. Confirm the host is reachable and points to the base URL, for example http://192.168.1.100:3333.
error.ml_auth_failed: The ML server rejected the token.
error.ml_image_fetch_failed: The ML server could not fetch or decode the camera image. Check Home Assistant Host and camera access from the ML server.
